Converted input speed (m/s) to km/h using factor 3.6 before serialization. Adjusted speeding threshold from 30 m/s to 108 km/h (equivalent). Changed runtime observation key from speed_mps to speed_kph.
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: Updated field names from speedMps to speedKph in both encoding and decoding to match protobuf schema change from speed_mps to speed_kph. Converted request.speed (m/s) to km/h by multiplying with 3.6 before encoding. Updated speeding threshold from 30.0 m/s to 108.0 km/h (equivalent). Changed output field from speed_mps to speed_kph to match new runtime observation key.
